title: Moving Day
novel:
Ted and Robin had been dating for nearly a year, and it was time for the [[big|big]] step. "Let's move in together," Ted said. Robin's smile [[froze|freeze]] for just a [[fraction|fraction]] of a second. "Absolutely!" she said. But her voice was a little too high, a little too [[cheerful|cheer]].

Marshall and Lily were [[thrilled|thrill]] to have the apartment to themselves again. "Finally, no more Ted!" Marshall said, then caught himself. "I mean... we'll miss you, [[buddy|buddy]]."

The move was a [[disaster|disaster]]. Ted's [[furniture|furniture]] was too big for Robin's apartment. Robin's five dogs — yes, five — [[hated|hate]] Ted. One of them [[chewed|chew]] through Ted's favorite [[pillow|pillow]]. Another one [[peed|pee]] on his box of [[childhood|childhood]] [[photographs|photograph]].

"You have five dogs," Ted said slowly. "I forgot to [[mention|mention]] that," Robin said. "You really did."

But the hardest part was the [[realization|realize]] that living together was not just about [[sharing|share]] space. It was about [[discovering|discover]] all the little things you did not know about each other — like the fact that Robin [[sang|sing]] "We [[Built|Build]] This City" every single morning at 6 AM, or that Ted [[organized|organize]] his [[cereal|cereal]] boxes by [[alphabetical|alphabet]] order.

On the [[third|third]] night, they sat on the floor surrounded by boxes and laughed until they cried. "This is a [[nightmare|nightmare]]," Robin said. "The best nightmare," Ted replied. Because moving in together was not the end of the [[honeymoon|honeymoon]] phase. It was the beginning of something even better — the [[messy|mess]], [[beautiful|beautiful]] truth of two people who chose each other, dogs and all.

realization.en: the moment when you understand something clearly

discover.en: to find or learn something for the first time

sing.en: to make musical sounds with your voice

alphabetical.en: arranged in the order of letters from A to Z

nightmare.en: a very frightening dream; a terrible experience

honeymoon.en: a holiday taken by a couple after their wedding; an early happy period
